# deployment

```go
import "github.com/blanketops/environments/pkg/secrets/git/deployment"
```

Package deployment reconciles the Deployment git\-ssh clone secret — the same ExternalSecret lifecycle as the Build variant \(pkg/secrets/git/build\), scoped to the Deployment's manifests repository.

Delete removes both the ExternalSecret and the Secret ESO materialized from it. See BuildGitSSHSecretReconciler.Delete for why the Secret must be deleted explicitly rather than left to the ExternalSecret's ownerReference GC cascade.
